info.title: Rental Foundation API
info.description: Phase 1 foundation and Phase 2 fleet, customer and private-document APIs. Livewire invokes the same application actions. Sanctum bearer token role and ability checks apply.

get.description: Required permission: authenticated. User role and token scope are both enforced. Pagination uses page (20 per page); no search/date filters in Phase 1. HTTP status codes are stable; messages are localized.

get.description: Permission: fleet.view. Both role and token scope apply. Archived records retain history.

Permission: fleet.view for vehicle documents; customer-documents.view for customer documents. Both role and token scope apply. Archived records retain history. Returns attachment with nosniff and private/no-store headers. Storage paths are never exposed.

delete.description: Permission: documents.remove. Both role and token scope apply. Archived records retain history.

password.description: Required on creation, optional on update. Resets force a password change and revoke sessions/tokens.

daily_rate.description: Nonnegative DZD amount with at most two decimal digits. daily_rate is required.

weekly_rate.description: Nonnegative DZD amount with at most two decimal digits. daily_rate is required.

monthly_rate.description: Nonnegative DZD amount with at most two decimal digits. daily_rate is required.

version.description: Required on update; stale version returns 409.

type.description: Vehicle: insurance, inspection, registration, maintenance. Customer: identity, licence.
